svg.title: Public holidays, per location — SoftTrack web design mockup (#250)
svg.desc: A team spread over Karachi, Berlin and Lagos has three sets of public holidays. HR keeps named holiday calendars with their dates and working weekdays, each person has a calendar as its own field, leave and balances skip the person’s holidays, and the team calendar and sprint capacity use them.
